mcqs.question: What is the main purpose of conducting a scientific investigation?

options.A: To prove a hypothesis before testing it
options.B: To explore a question and find an answer

mcqs.answer: To explore a question and find an answer
mcqs.explanation: The purpose of an investigation is to explore a question and discover an answer based on evidence. It is not to prove something in advance or to memorize facts.

mcqs.learning_point: Changing one relevant factor at a time where appropriate
mcqs.question: When testing how sunlight affects plant growth, which method follows the principle of changing one factor at a time?

options.A: Change both the amount of sunlight and the amount of water together
options.B: Keep the amount of sunlight the same and change the type of soil
options.C: Keep the soil type the same and change only the amount of sunlight

mcqs.answer: Keep the soil type the same and change only the amount of sunlight
mcqs.explanation: Changing only the amount of sunlight while keeping all other relevant conditions (like soil type) constant isolates the effect of sunlight on growth, which is the correct scientific approach.

mcqs.question: In a fair investigation, what does it mean to keep other relevant conditions controlled?

options.A: Ignore them because they are not important
options.B: Change them randomly during the experiment
options.C: Keep them the same throughout the experiment
options.D: Record them but do not try to keep them constant

mcqs.answer: Keep them the same throughout the experiment
mcqs.explanation: Controlling other relevant conditions means maintaining them at the same level so that any change in the result can be attributed to the factor being tested, not to other variables.

mcqs.question: Why is it important to make repeated observations during an experiment?

options.A: To waste time and make the experiment longer
options.B: To confirm that the results are consistent and reliable
options.C: To confuse the data and make analysis harder

mcqs.answer: To confirm that the results are consistent and reliable
mcqs.explanation: Repeated observations allow the investigator to see if the same result occurs each time, which increases confidence that the findings are reliable and not due to chance.

mcqs.question: Sam measures the temperature of water every minute and writes down the numbers. Which action shows honest recording of results?

options.A: Writing down the exact numbers he observed each time
options.B: Changing the numbers so they match the pattern he expected
options.C: Guessing the temperature when he forgets to look at the thermometer
options.D: Copying the numbers from a textbook instead of his own measurements

mcqs.answer: Writing down the exact numbers he observed each time
mcqs.explanation: Honest recording means documenting exactly what was observed, without altering or guessing values to fit a preconceived idea.

mcqs.question: After testing two types of paper to see which absorbs more water, Maya concludes that Type A absorbs more because her measurements show higher values. How is she using the results?

options.A: She is using them as proof to support her claim
options.B: She is ignoring them and making a guess
options.C: She is changing them to fit her expectation
options.D: She is using them as evidence for her conclusion

mcqs.answer: She is using them as evidence for her conclusion
mcqs.explanation: Maya is basing her conclusion on the measured data; the data serve as evidence that supports her claim about which paper absorbs more water.

mcqs.question: Which statement correctly recognises a limitation of an investigation?

options.A: My results are perfect and can be applied to every situation everywhere
options.B: My experiment only tested one type of soil, so the results may not apply to other soils
options.C: I don’t need to repeat the test because one trial is enough
options.D: The equipment always works flawlessly, so there are no errors

mcqs.answer: My experiment only tested one type of soil, so the results may not apply to other soils
mcqs.explanation: Acknowledging that the study examined only one soil type shows awareness of a limitation; results might differ with other soils. The other options ignore or deny possible limitations.

mcqs.question: A student wants to know why a metal rod becomes hot when placed in sunlight. What is the primary purpose of this investigation?

options.A: To prove that the metal rod is magical
options.B: To discover the cause of the rod’s heating
options.C: To memorize the color of the rod
options.D: To compare the rod with a wooden stick for fun

mcqs.answer: To discover the cause of the rod’s heating
mcqs.explanation: The investigation aims to find out the reason (cause) behind the rod heating up, which aligns with the purpose of scientific inquiry—to explain observed phenomena.
